resources.string: Connect this phone and your PlayStation Portal to the same trusted LAN. Set the Portal’s manual HTTP proxy to the phone address and port below. Only the listed Portal IP is allowed.

The manual LAN proxy supports HTTP/HTTPS CONNECT only, not UDP games or streaming. With background sharing enabled, removing the app from Recents keeps sharing. Android force-stop, battery or OEM controls may interrupt the service.
No private IPv4 address found. Connect to your trusted Wi-Fi network first.
The subscription URL stays in memory only and is never saved by this app. Re-enter it after closing the app. Native proxy-provider credentials may be cached privately by the engine while running.
Phone proxying may prevent access to local devices, including in Direct mode. Turn it off to restore normal networking.

Off by default. Start requests Android VPN consent when enabled, and another VPN cannot run at the same time. Phone routing supports TCP/UDP. UDP unsupported by the selected node is blocked, without direct fallback. ICMP (ping) is unsupported, some apps may be incompatible, and encrypted DNS may limit domain rules.
Shows phone-app proxy status with a Stop all proxying action
Phone-app VPN connected · tap for proxy status
Another VPN is active. Phone proxy did not start.
VPN consent was denied or revoked.
Phone VPN could not start. Check Android consent and retry.
Phone VPN was interrupted. Check LAN sharing on the main screen.

When enabled, this session’s LAN sharing and phone proxy continue on Home, screen lock and removal from Recents. When disabled, leaving this screen stops all proxying. Android force-stop, battery or OEM controls may still interrupt the service.
Shows when the LAN proxy is active and provides an immediate Stop action
LAN proxy ready · tap to open or Stop below
Closing the listener and active connections
Allow notifications to start the proxy. The persistent notification keeps its Stop action within reach.
Notifications are disabled. Enable notifications for OnDemand in Android Settings, then tap Start again.
Allow local network access so your Portal can connect to this phone. No connection starts until you allow it.
Permission was not granted. The proxy is stopped.
Android could not start the foreground service. Keep this app open, check its permissions, then try again.
The configured LAN address is no longer available. The proxy has stopped; reconnect to Wi-Fi and start again.
License assets are missing. Rebuild with the bundled dependency notices before distributing this app.
